clock.title: Desktop clock
clock.description: The clock key on your strip. Its ‹ and › buttons switch and save the theme too.
clock.secondsHint: Off shows hours and minutes only.
clock.themeDescription: Built-in art, or your own image or video of at least 2 seconds per theme.

clock.openDesktop: Open the desktop app to change clock settings.

clock.saveFailed: Settings could not be saved. Please retry.
clock.ipLookup: Find my city from my IP address
clock.ipConsent: Off by default. With an empty city, this sends your public IP address to ipapi.co, or ipwho.is if that fails, to estimate your city. Enter a city above to use weather without IP lookup.

regionSuggestions.advisory: Suggestions only. Configure a provider and credentials in settings to use it. Existing choices stay selected.

clock.ipConsent: Desactivado por defecto. Sin ciudad, se envía tu IP pública a ipapi.co, o a ipwho.is si falla, para estimar tu ciudad. Introduce una ciudad arriba para usar el tiempo sin buscar la IP.

clock.ipConsent: Désactivé par défaut. Sans ville, votre IP publique est envoyée à ipapi.co, ou à ipwho.is en cas d’échec, pour estimer votre ville. Saisissez une ville ci-dessus pour éviter la recherche IP.

clock.ipConsent: 기본적으로 꺼져 있습니다. 도시가 비어 있으면 공개 IP 주소를 ipapi.co로 보내고, 실패하면 ipwho.is로 보내 도시를 추정합니다. IP 조회 없이 날씨를 사용하려면 위에 도시를 입력하세요.
